overview_description.description: FriendyCar is a peer-to-peer car sharing and vehicle rental marketplace operating in the Middle East, allowing car owners to lend their vehicles to users seeking short-term transportation options. The platform facilitates car rentals through a digital marketplace model that connects vehicle owners and renters, with operations focused primarily in countries such as the UAE and Egypt. Founded in 2016, the company provides booking, payment, and vehicle management services aimed at enabling flexible and community-based mobility solutions.
